value.rationale: The exact index-two nilpotent count is a canonical point-count invariant of commuting varieties, uniform over all finite fields and an infinite two-parameter hook family. The proof isolates an unexpectedly strict parity gap after dividing out the obvious \(q^{\lfloor n/2\rfloor}\) factor and identifies the rank-stratified mechanism. The result answers a well-motivated enumerative question that possible-Jordan-type classifications and centralizer-dimension formulas leave open.
